lesson_text: In Claude-fixer mode the review workflow checks `MAX_AUTOFIX_ITERATIONS` before it reviews, so the head carrying the last allowed `[claude-autofix]` commit is never reviewed: the PR is labelled `ai:review-blocked` with no finding open. Expect that hand-back after the cap-th fix, and clear it with a `[claude-intervention]` commit (which restarts the count) plus removing the label, instead of looking for a finding to fix.
